description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android wearable app. It sets up the UI components including a GridViewPager with custom margin adjustments based on device shape and a DotsPageIndicator for navigation.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for setting up the grid view pager and navigation indicator, handling window insets for round displays.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures the pager with margins and adapter, and links the dots indicator.
